name: Rogue Warlock
detailed_description:
Rogue Warlock is an action rogue-lite game currently in development. Play as a warlock traversing a phantasmal dungeon, summoning demons to defeat enemies, gaining power, and escaping with your sanity intact.

Rogue Warlock is based around a modular character progression system intended to create deep and varied possibilities for character builds. Defeat hordes of enemies and challenging bosses on your path out of the dungeon. Designed for heavy replayablitiy, each playthrough allows builds which combine new summons, augments, and perks to create emergent strategies and survive the dungeon.

short_description: Employ magic and moxie to escape the dungeon in this new indie action rogue-lite! Fight enemies and powerful bosses, collect loot, construct synergistic builds, and flee the dungeon. Explore and master the game's unique character progression system in this arcade style hack-and-slash rogue-lite.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Additional Notes: Requires Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system
